input_contract: Use only event_id, description, outcome_text, and the typed query.

outcome_rule.failure_or_no_change_sentence: Do not update current tracked state.
outcome_rule.successful_resultative_sentence: Update only the state fact explicitly expressed by the event description.

language_semantics: A successful description that says an entity was opened or closed establishes its current openness.
A successful description that says an entity was switched or turned on/off establishes its current power state.
A successful pickup description establishes that the object is held by agent_1.
A successful placement description using on establishes on(destination); using inside establishes inside(destination).
provenance_boundary: This specification exposes no canonical action API, place_effect field, old state, Oracle answer, or simulator metadata.
